crossRefs.note: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul’s servants said to him, “See now, an evil spirit from God troubles you.
translations.bsb: Saul’s servants said to him, “Surely a spirit of distress from God is tormenting you.
translations.kjv: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.
translations.asv: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.
